full_details: Fog had been up since noon. You were at the lodging until you walked to the reckoning. Titus played without you, and the last torches stood in haloes. Heminges counted thirty-four shillings. Last week was thirty-five. You did not add either sum to a coffer. The Rose title was Wise Man, and there was no receipt. At the stair you took one candle and said you would sit. On the sheet, her face makes the vault a feasting presence. Then the drug, the kiss, five words you did not copy out, her waking, the Friar's fear, the watch, and the dagger. The families are not fetched. You did not walk a line. At midnight you said he gets it wrong by a minute.
one_sentence: You took thirty-four shillings by candle, then sat to the vault and stopped when the dagger was in its sheath.
title: One candle, as far as the dagger
